scripts.check:be:lint: uv run ruff check ergon_core ergon_builtins ergon_cli ergon_infra ergon_ingestion tests
scripts.check:be:fmt: uv run ruff format --check ergon_core ergon_builtins ergon_cli ergon_infra ergon_ingestion tests
scripts.check:be:type: uv run ty check ergon_core/ergon_core ergon_builtins/ergon_builtins ergon_cli/ergon_cli ergon_infra ergon_ingestion/ergon_ingestion
scripts.check:be:slopcop: uv run slopcop --warn-only ergon_core/ergon_core ergon_builtins/ergon_builtins ergon_cli/ergon_cli ergon_infra ergon_ingestion/ergon_ingestion
scripts.check:be:complexity: uv run xenon --max-absolute F --max-modules E --max-average C ergon_core ergon_builtins ergon_cli ergon_infra ergon_ingestion
scripts.check:be: pnpm run check:be:lint && pnpm run check:be:fmt && pnpm run check:be:type && pnpm run check:be:slopcop && pnpm run check:be:suppression-budget && pnpm run check:be:complexity
scripts.test:full:unit: uv run pytest ergon_core/tests/unit ergon_builtins/tests/unit ergon_cli/tests/unit ergon_ingestion/tests/unit -q -n auto --durations=20
scripts.test:be:coverage: uv run pytest ergon_core/tests/unit ergon_builtins/tests/unit ergon_cli/tests/unit ergon_ingestion/tests/unit tests/integration --cov=ergon_core --cov=ergon_builtins --cov-report=term-missing --cov-report=xml:coverage.xml
scripts.test:be:integration: uv run ergon test backend integration
scripts.test:be:all: uv run ergon test full unit && uv run ergon test backend integration
scripts.test:be:e2e: uv run ergon test backend e2e
scripts.test:be:real-llm: uv run ergon test real-llm full
scripts.check:fe: pnpm run check:fe:lint && pnpm run check:fe:type
scripts.test:fe:e2e:live: uv run ergon test dashboard smoke
scripts.check:fast: pnpm run check:be && pnpm run check:fe
